continuity_law.missing_or_corrupt_fails_closed: Missing or corrupt continuity fails closed (INV-10).
continuity_law.successor_ready_requires_experience: A successor packet may be issued only when preserved experience exists (executor: successor_not_ready until record_experience; degraded mode with logged gap when successor context unavailable — V1 failure table).

fail_closed_law: Any SELF state claim violating any gate above is INVALID. UNKNOWN != PASS: a missing field is a failure, never an assumption. A full loop history with empty evidence fails every gate it claims. Identity claims are not evidence of identity. Successor context is not authority.
governing_law: Subordinate to the Constitution and to Prime Operating Law 1 (Human Director Ratified 2026-09-30, SN-016 — Judgment Before Blind Obedience). This contract creates no authority; capability never creates authority. Constitutional ratification is human-only.

identity_law.explicit_attributable: Identity is explicit and attributable (INV-01); it is established and verifiable before any kernel operation (V1 acceptance).
identity_law.identity_preserved_across_transitions: Identity persists across context resets and transitions (V1 MUST + acceptance).
identity_law.mission_objective_before_work: Mission and objective exist before consequential work (INV-04); operating without a declared objective is a MUST NOT violation (V1).
identity_law.never_inferred_from_display_name: Runtime identity is never inferred from display name alone (INV-03).
identity_law.no_fabrication: Fabricated identity is a MUST NOT violation (V1): identity_missing fails closed.
identity_law.role_enum: role must be exactly one of roles (below).

purpose: The machine-checkable layer of the SELF organ: the canonical identity-and-continuity lifecycle, the legal loop transitions, the fail-closed gates that decide whether a claimed SELF state is honored, and the exact binding to the merged JSON schema and the merged runtime executor. A state claim is honored only when the evidence its gate requires is present. UNKNOWN != PASS.
record_law: Records (when present) are worked lifecycle records, not a store of identity. Each record must carry a non-empty unique record_id, a loop_stage exactly one of loop_stages, stage_history == loop_stages[0..index(loop_stage)] exactly, and the evidence every gate through its stage requires.

CONTINUE.rule: inherited_intelligence must be a non-empty list and proof_ref non-empty: continuation uses inherited intelligence only with a proof reference; continuity requires a legitimate binding or recovery mechanism (INV-07).

ESTABLISH.rule: identity_attestation must be an object with non-empty actor_id, non-empty system_id, and role in roles (below). Runtime identity is never inferred from display name alone (INV-03). mission_source must name the canonical authority the mission was loaded from — mission is loaded, never invented (INV-12). objective must be non-empty: mission and objective exist before consequential work (INV-04).

HAND_OFF.rule: successor_packet must be an object with schema == naya.self.successor.v2, non-empty predecessor_id and system_id (system identity stable across succession, INV-02; predecessor binding enforced by the executor), and authority_transferred == false explicitly. Successor context never creates authority (INV-08): the packet transfers intelligence, not authority.

PRESERVE.rule: checkpoint_id must match ^CHK-[0-9a-f]{24}$: durable checkpoints are content-addressed (INV-09), consistent with the merged executor checkpoint_id(payload) = CHK- + sha256[:24].

REFLECT.rule: audit_trail must be a non-empty list of non-empty strings: auditable reconstruction of what changed and why (responsibility 8).

REMEMBER.rule: experience_preserved must be true and experience_ref non-empty: retained meaningful outcomes through the canonical intelligence boundary (responsibility 7).

RESTORE.rule: continuity_binding must be an object with either checkpoint_id matching ^CHK-[0-9a-f]{24}$ (a content-addressed durable checkpoint, INV-09) or declared_fresh == true with a named reason (fresh start with no prior store). Missing or corrupt continuity fails closed — never assumed (INV-10).

UNDERSTAND.rule: known_unknown_boundary must be an object with known, unknown, blocked arrays. The boundary must be explicit; UNKNOWN remains UNKNOWN until evidence changes its state (INV-05); BLOCKED remains BLOCKED (INV-06).

scope: Identity lifecycle: establishment, attribution, preservation across context transitions
North-star loop law: ESTABLISH -> RESTORE -> UNDERSTAND -> REMEMBER -> REFLECT -> PRESERVE -> HAND OFF -> CONTINUE (forward-only, one stage at a time, no skips, no backward moves)
Continuity mechanics: content-addressed checkpoints, successor packets, boot receipts, fail-closed recovery
Authority separation: SELF is continuity, not authority; successor packets transfer intelligence, never authority
Binding: consistency between this contract, SELF-NODE-SCHEMA.json, and the merged runtime error/receipt vocabulary

transition_law.rule: A record at loop stage N must carry stage_history == loop_stages[0..N] exactly. A claim at a stage is honored only when every stage up to and including that stage passes its evidence gate.
